# arubasdwan_app_address_maps (Data Source)

Fetches the user-defined address maps from the Aruba SD-WAN Orchestrator via `GET /gms/rest/applicationDefinition?base=ipIntelligenceClassification&resourceKey=userDefined`. An address map classifies an IPv4 address range as a named application, which security policies and overlay ACLs can then match by name.

Supported on Orchestrator 9.6.3 and 9.7.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arubasdwan_app_address_maps" "all" {}

output "address_maps" {
  value = {
    for m in data.arubasdwan_app_address_maps.all.address_maps :
    m.name => m.ip_start == m.ip_end ? m.ip_start : "${m.ip_start}-${m.ip_end}"
  }
}

# Which ranges belong to a given organization?
output "partner_ranges" {
  value = [
    for m in data.arubasdwan_app_address_maps.all.address_maps : m.name
    if m.org == "Partner Inc"
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `address_maps` (Attributes List) List of address maps, sorted by the start address of their range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--address_maps))

<a id="nestedatt--address_maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `address_maps`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Country name associated with the range.
- `country_code` (String) Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `description` (String) Description of the entry.
- `ip_end` (String) Last IPv4 address of the range, in dotted notation. Equal to ip_start for a single host.
- `ip_start` (String) First IPv4 address of the range, in dotted notation.
- `name` (String) Name of the application.
- `org` (String) Organization associated with the range.
- `priority` (Number) Classification priority; a higher value takes precedence over a lower one.
- `service_id` (Number) Service ID assigned by the Orchestrator.
